_note: SOURCE-DERIVED fixtures built from MeshCore commit 81dbae5 (examples/companion_radio/MyMesh.cpp, src/Packet.cpp). NOT captured from a radio; replace with captures after the radio run in docs/protocol/chat-spikes-2026-11.md

path_len_encoding.rule: byte = ((hash_size-1)<<6) | hop_count; hash_size 4 (top bits 11) reserved/invalid; hop_count*hash_size <= 64

push_0x8d_path_discovery.layout: [0x8D][0x00][pubkey prefix 6][out_path_len][out_path bytes][in_path_len][in_path bytes]; telemetry in response is discarded by firmware

cmd_50_binary_req_min_max_avg.layout: [50][pubkey 32][0x04][start_secs_ago u32 LE][end_secs_ago u32 LE][0][0]; answered only by sensor firmware (SensorMesh), role >= READ_ONLY; reply push 0x8C [0][tag u32][ now u32 ][ch][lpp_type][min][max][avg]...

resp_16_contact_msg_v3.layout: [0x10][snr*4 i8][0][0][prefix 6][path_len byte or 0xFF][txt_type][ts u32 LE][text]; NO RSSI field (reserved bytes are zero)

text_limits.channel_formula: len(sender_name)+2+len(text) <= 160, firmware silently truncates the tail
